latest_release.name: November 2026 update
latest_release.body:
# OpenStock v2026.11.09: November update

OpenStock is a free, open-source (AGPL-3.0) alternative to paid market platforms. Use it at https://openstock-ods.vercel.app or self-host it with every feature.

This release covers everything on `main` up to #153. The previous tag was [`v2026.10.25`](https://github.com/Open-Dev-Society/OpenStock/releases/tag/v2026.10.25). The full history, with per-release credits, is on the [changelog](https://openstock-ods.vercel.app/changelog).

## New since v2026.10.25

- **🇸🇦 Saudi Arabia (Tadawul) on the dashboard:** TASI, Aramco, Al Rajhi and STC tiles, today's movers and a quotes table, all priced from Yahoo Finance (delayed), because TradingView blocks Tadawul in embeds. Saudi stock pages and watchlist rows show the price too, and the market clock knows Tadawul trades Sunday to Thursday. #145 (adapted from #142 by @ahmaddirar-ios)
- **🇵🇱 Poland (GPW Warsaw) on the dashboard:** WIG20, WIG, mWIG40 and sWIG80 tiles, movers and 15 blue chips, priced from Yahoo Finance (delayed), because TradingView embeds have Warsaw end of day only. Polish stock pages keep the TradingView chart. The Yahoo code now works from a small exchange table, so adding the next market is a one-entry change. #147 (@pawisoon)
- **Fewer failing requests on non-US stock pages:** Finnhub free has company data for US listings only, so OpenStock no longer asks it for metrics or company news elsewhere. The dividend card is left out where the answer can't be known. #153
- **Changelog:** a November update entry, and a README contributors table regenerated from the changelog credits. #152

## Thank you

@ahmaddirar-ios and @pawisoon for the two new markets, and everyone whose pull requests were merged into OpenStock:

@ravixalgorithm @keshav-005 @octo-patch @akoweicollinxx @chinnsenn @nb-src @CrixusWen @TPTBusiness @alexander-schneider @Bortlesboat @Chukwuebuka-2003 @kuishou68 @BambaSatoru @Yi-111-a @cosark @muskanbandta23 @cosmind-rusu @samki6576 @ahmaddirar-ios @pawisoon

People whose issues led to fixes are credited per release on the [changelog](https://openstock-ods.vercel.app/changelog).

OpenStock stays free thanks to sponsors: [GitHub Sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/ravixalgorithm) · [sponsor page](https://openstock-ods.vercel.app/sponsor).
